identity_preimage_slots.description: The eight positive-preimage slots (spec section 4.4) for the identity point, in slot order. Every value maps to the identity under MAP. 0 and SQRT_ID each occur twice; this is why profile keys whose masked form is 0 or SQRT_ID cannot be decrypted (see profile_key_ciphertexts).

source.description: Vectors for the non-credential half of libsignal zkgroup used by Signal groups v2 (group master key -> secret/public params and group identifier, service-ID and profile-key ciphertexts, group blob encryption, server public params, notary signatures). See spec/crypto/zkgroup-groups.md. All hex is lowercase. Points are 32-byte ristretto255 encodings (RFC 9496), scalars 32-byte little-endian reduced mod the group order. UUIDs are written canonically; their 16-byte form is RFC 9562 order.

provenance.config: Copied as data from signal-cli v0.14.7 lib/src/main/java/org/asamk/signal/manager/config/{StagingConfig,LiveConfig}.java; validity checked by parsing in the jar; component split by the spec agent per spec section 8.
provenance.derived: Intermediates (M1, M2, M3, M4, derived scalars, identity slots, decrypt match counts, server/poksho public keys) computed by the spec agent with a throwaway scratch implementation of the spec (not delivered, deleted). It reproduced every jar ciphertext, every jar decryption outcome (including the failures), all secret/public params, every upstream fixed vector in this file and the hardcoded system params, so the intermediates are consistent with libsignal but are not exposed by libsignal itself.
provenance.jar: Computed offline with the reference distribution: jshell over /work/third_party/signal-cli-0.14.7/lib/*.jar (libsignal-client 0.99.1 with its native library), via the public Java API (GroupSecretParams, ClientZkGroupCipher, ServerSecretParams, ServerPublicParams, GenericServerPublicParams) and the public deterministic JNI entry points org.signal.libsignal.internal.Native.GroupSecretParams_EncryptBlobWithPaddingDeterministic / GroupSecretParams_DecryptBlobWithPadding. Deterministic randomness was supplied through a SecureRandom subclass returning fixed bytes. No network.
provenance.jar+bouncycastle: Inner AES-256-GCM-SIV encryption done with BouncyCastle GCMSIVBlockCipher (bcprov-jdk18on-1.85.jar from the same distribution) under the blob key read from the jar's GroupSecretParams; decryption result from the jar.
provenance.upstream: Copied as data from libsignal tests/constants at the commit above; the 'source_file' member names the file.
